_about: Settings for housekeeper.py's optional memory judge on a Windows worker (needs the agy CLI). There are no keep or close lists: a model decides from the unfinished mail threads. `notes` are context it weighs, not rules. Re-read every pass.
notes: A Chrome tab group holds the tabs of one piece of agent work, named after it.
The Discord desktop app is not used by the agents; the bridge talks to Discord through its bot.
